storeCopy.seoTitle: Instagram Tagged Posts Scraper | Public Mentions
storeCopy.seoDescription: Find public Instagram posts tagging an account, with captions, engagement, authors, and links. Batch usernames and page through tagged results.
storeCopy.intro: Find public Instagram posts that tag an account and collect captions, engagement, media links, and publisher profiles. Add multiple usernames and follow available result pages.
useCases: Brand teams can monitor public posts that tag a company account.
Creator managers can review tagged content across several public profiles.
Researchers can study how accounts appear in public community posts.
howToUse: Add each public account username to `usernames`.
Set `maxPages` to limit cursor pagination for each account.
Export post captions, authors, and links with `maxResults` set to your run cap.

faqs.question: Does this include private posts?
faqs.answer: No. Results depend on public tagged-post data available from Instagram.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Instagram media identifier for the post where the account is tagged.

fields.name: shortcode
fields.description: Short code used in the public Instagram post URL.

fields.name: media_type
fields.description: Instagram format label for the tagged post.

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Caption text published with the tagged post.

fields.name: hashtags
fields.description: Hashtags extracted from the tagged post caption.

fields.name: taken_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 posting time when Instagram provides it.

fields.name: taken_at_timestamp
fields.description: Unix posting timestamp when Instagram provides it.

fields.name: like_count
fields.description: Number of likes reported for the tagged post.

fields.name: comment_count
fields.description: Number of comments reported for the tagged post.

fields.name: play_count
fields.description: Video play count when the tagged post is a video; otherwise null.

fields.name: view_count
fields.description: Video view count when the tagged post is a video; otherwise null.

fields.name: media
fields.description: Image or video assets attached to the tagged post.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Location attached to the tagged post, or null when none is reported.

fields.name: author
fields.description: Public profile details for the account that published the tagged post.

fields.name: collaborators
fields.description: Public collaborator profiles attached to the post, when present.

fields.name: tagged_users
fields.description: Public profile records tagged in the post, when present.

fields.name: is_paid_partnership
fields.description: True when Instagram marks the post as a paid partnership.

fields.name: product_type
fields.description: Instagram publishing format for the tagged post.

fields.name: permalink
fields.description: Public Instagram URL for the tagged post.

fields.name: accessibility_caption
fields.description: Accessibility description of the media, or null when Instagram has none.

fields.name: author_id
fields.description: Instagram identifier for the account that published the post.

fields.name: author_username
fields.description: Public handle of the account that published the post, when available.

fields.name: author_verified
fields.description: True when Instagram marks the posting account as verified.

fields.name: input_username
fields.description: Instagram username used to retrieve this account’s posts.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC date and time when this record was collected.
